verdict.rationale: Belvo runs its own recurring background jobs. Recurrent links refresh data weekly and notify the user via webhook, and Smart Transfers and Direct Debit automate recurring payments. These are fixed, product-specific recurrences rather than a general facility for users to define and schedule their own jobs or workflows. missing for 10: user-configurable schedules (custom cadence or cron-like control), general workflow scheduling beyond link refresh and payments, detailed scheduling docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: With recurrent links, Belvo automatically refreshes information weekly and notifies you via webhook so you always have up-to-date data.
Smart Transfers — Automate recurring payments with Pix
Direct Debit — Accept recurring bank payments seamlessly
